description:
About the company
 Our client is a software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Keep live model serving systems running fast and reliably after launch, acting as the main technical contact for a set of major accounts. The role combines hands-on performance tuning with passing practical lessons back to product, engineering and research teams.
 What you'll do
 - Keep production model serving systems fast and stable after they go live.
 - Configure and tune open-source inference software to meet throughput and latency goals.
 - Serve as the primary technical contact for key accounts, spending most of the week on customer-facing work.
 - Share learnings with product, engineering and research teams, including contributing code written for a customer back to the product.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Hands-on experience speeding up language model serving on live systems that run open-weight models.
 - Experience running open-weight language model serving software in production using Python.
 - Working knowledge of model compression, faster decoding methods, attention cache management, request batching and multi-GPU model splitting.
 - Background in a customer-facing engineering role focused on model serving performance or inference solutions.
 - Ability to speak fluently and keep pace in a live technical conversation without relying on notes.
 Bonus points
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering or another STEM field, or a master's or PhD in machine learning or a related field.
 - Experience owning technical delivery for a customer through to production, beyond a demo.
 - Familiarity with metrics and monitoring tools for reviewing model serving performance.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: $216K - $240K
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States: hybrid, 4 days a week in office (preferred location)
 - New York, NY, United States: hybrid, 2 to 3 days a week in office
 - Full-time
